title: Latent Fusion: Channel Stacking for Structure-Preserving Image Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.18727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Instruction-based image editing models must condition on the source image, either by sequence concatenation, which appends source tokens to the target sequence (FLUX.1 Kontext), or by channel-wise concatenation, which stacks the source latent onto the noisy latent and widens the input projection (InstructPix2Pix, FLUX.1 Fill). The FLUX.1 Kontext report found channel-wise concatenation worse in initial experiments at 1K resolution with a 12B model and a large corpus. We explore channel-wise concatenation as the lower-cost option for a common production regime: structure-preserving edits that change appearance (sky, exposure, foliage, cleanup) but not layout, about 1,400 training pairs, a 4B non-distilled backbone, and 2K frames. It keeps the sequence at its original length, where sequence concatenation doubles it and roughly quadruples attention cost, and needs only single-scale classifier-free guidance (two forward passes per step inst

translated_title: 潜空间融合：面向结构保持图像编辑的通道堆叠方法
translated_abstract: 基于指令的图像编辑模型必须以源图像为条件，主要有两种方式：一是序列拼接，即将源图像的token附加到目标序列中（如FLUX.1 Kontext）；二是通道级拼接，即将源图像的潜变量堆叠到含噪潜变量上并加宽输入投影（如InstructPix2Pix、FLUX.1 Fill）。FLUX.1 Kontext报告曾指出，在1K分辨率、12B模型和大规模语料库的初步实验中，通道级拼接表现较差。我们探索将通道级拼接作为更低成本的方案，应用于一个常见的生产场景：改变外观但不改变布局的结构保持类编辑（如天空、曝光、植被、清理），采用约1,400个训练对、4B非蒸馏骨干网络和2K分辨率图像。该方法保持序列的原始长度不变，而序列拼接会使序列长度加倍、注意力成本约增至四倍，且只需单尺度无分类器引导（每步两次前向传播……）。
tldr: 该论文提出“潜空间融合”方法，证明在结构保持类图像编辑的生产场景下（约1,400个训练对、4B骨干、2K分辨率），通道级潜变量堆叠是比序列拼接更低成本的条件注入方式，可在保持序列长度不变的同时将注意力开销降低约四倍。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes "Latent Fusion," demonstrating that channel-wise latent stacking is a cost-effective alternative to sequence concatenation for structure-preserving image editing, keeping sequence length unchanged and avoiding the roughly fourfold attention cost with only ~1,400 training pairs and a 4B backbone.
